Container.Name: Plexcache-D
Container.Overview: Automate Plex media management: Efficiently transfer media from the On Deck/Watchlist to an SSD cache, and seamlessly move watched media back to their respective locations. This app reduces energy consumption by minimizing the need to spin up the array/hard drive(s) when watching recurrent media like TV series. It achieves this by moving the media from the OnDeck and watchlist for the main user and/or other users. For TV shows/anime, it also fetches the next specified number of episodes. Optionally add Jellyfin 10.9+ alongside Plex, so Jellyfin users' Continue Watching and Next Up are cached too.
Container.Changes: ### 3.3.0 (November 2026) - Optional Jellyfin support alongside Plex: Continue Watching, Next Up and favorites - Recently Added page and dashboard widget - Watched files that were never backed up are handed back to the Unraid mover instead of being copied - API key so Tautulli or Home Assistant can start a run - Safer cache copies: Plex never sees a half-copied file - Reworked status pill, phone layouts and light theme fixes - Docker v2 manifests, so Unraid's update check works - Full list: https://github.com/StudioNirin/PlexCache-D/blob/main/CHANGELOG.txt
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex jellyfin cache mover ssd array spindown ondeck watchlist media
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server must be accessible from this container. Optional: Jellyfin 10.9 or newer, alongside Plex (it does not replace Plex). Set the Jellyfin fields under Show more settings. CA Mover Tuning plugin recommended (optional) for mover exclude list integration.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent storage for settings, logs, and tracking data

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Your Unraid cache drive where media files are cached for fast access

Config.Name: Array
Config.Description: Direct array access (user0) for creating .plexcached backups

Config.Name: User
Config.Description: User share for Plex library path resolution

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users on Unraid)

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for accurate log timestamps and scheduling

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Optional. Adds Jellyfin 10.9+ alongside Plex, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Leave empty to use Plex only.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Create one in Jellyfin under Dashboard > API Keys.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Path Mappings
Config.Description: Needed for Jellyfin: a JSON object mapping each Jellyfin folder to the Plex path of the same folder, e.g. {"/media/movies": "/data/movies"}. Map a folder to itself if both servers see the same path. Jellyfin items outside these folders are skipped.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Skip Users
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated Jellyfin users to leave out, e.g. guest,kids

Config.Name: Jellyfin Favorites
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true to cache unplayed Jellyfin favorites like a watchlist (Jellyfin has no watchlist). Needs the watchlist turned on in PlexCache.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Web UI port for browser access

Config.Name: Unraid Notify Script
Config.Description: Unraid's notify script and PHP includes (for native notifications)
